changes.title: Scroll even when a swipe begins on a button
changes.text: A vertical swipe on About, APD Settings or Cleric Grudge now scrolls even when starting on a button or link. Moving far enough prevents the underlying control from clicking; an ordinary tap continues to work. Other scroll panes and slider gestures remain unchanged.

changes.title: Preserve scroll gesture and verification history
changes.text: Retain swipe-versus-tap and cancel regressions, an Android real-touch checkbox-origin swipe check, source/runner evidence, and every intervening documented verification and history record since the immediately previous compiled APK.
